gaps.sentence: The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
The ___ (OWN) of the car park charges by the hour.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — the person who owns it; 'ownership' is the state.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.

gaps.explanation: 'Studying management' — the field is called management.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.
